title: Zoning text change for Fort Hamilton Mews, Bay Ridge
summary: This application would amend the Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 9305 Fifth Avenue in the Bay Ridge neighborhood of Brooklyn. It works together with a related zoning map change to allow an 11-story mixed-use building with 292 apartments, about 88 of them permanently income-restricted. The Council approved the measure with modifications on October 8, 2026.
